justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/DynamicType.java` and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/DynamicTypeDefaultUnloadedTest.java`. `DynamicType.Unloaded` is a small nested interface with only 4 methods (`load` overloads and `include` overloads at lines 7266-7315), all focused on loading an unloaded dynamic type and adding auxiliary types; its default implementation `DynamicType.Default.Unloaded` is likewise compact, with one field plus those same 4 operations (lines 7681-7744). The test class exercises only these loading/inclusion behaviors, and I found no evidence of excessive size, many unrelated methods, or multiple responsibilities that would indicate insufficient modularization.
